title: SZZBench: Controlled Git Histories with Explicit Oracles for Diagnosing SZZ Implementations
abstract: arXiv:2611.17669v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The SZZ algorithm traces a bug-fixing commit back to the commits that introduced the bug. Its labels underlie defect-prediction data sets and many mining software repositories studies. SZZ implementations are mostly evaluated against oracles mined from real projects. Such oracles are realistic, but each case mixes the history factors that make an implementation succeed or fail, and an aggregate score cannot show why. We present SZZBench, a tool that shows why: it generates ordinary Git repositories from declarative scenarios with explicit oracles, scores the predictions of any SZZ implementation under declared evaluation policies, and reads each result against 26 naive baselines, such as always answering the second commit. SZZBench also checks the declarations of new scenarios, such as the tier, against the results of the naive baselines. translated_title: SZZBench：具有显式预言的受控Git历史记录，用于诊断SZZ实现
translated_abstract: SZZ算法将修复缺陷的提交回溯到引入该缺陷的提交，其标注结果是缺陷预测数据集以及众多软件仓库挖掘研究的基础。SZZ实现大多使用从真实项目中挖掘出的预言进行评估，这类预言虽然贴近现实，但每个案例都混合了多种决定实现成败的历史因素，而聚合得分无法揭示其中的原因。我们提出了SZZBench这一能够揭示原因的工具：它根据带有显式预言的声明式场景生成普通的Git仓库，在声明的评估策略下对任意SZZ实现的预测结果进行评分，并将每个结果与26个朴素基线（例如总是回答第二个提交）进行对比。SZZBench还会依据朴素基线的结果来校验新场景（例如层级）的声明。目前，SZZBench提供了17个类别共279个场景，以及四个SZZ工具的适配器。运行……
tldr: 论文提出SZZBench，一个通过声明式场景生成带有显式预言的受控Git仓库、并借助26个朴素基线诊断SZZ实现成败原因的评测工具，目前包含17个类别共279个场景及四个SZZ工具的适配器。
en_tdlr: SZZBench generates controlled Git repositories from declarative scenarios with explicit oracles and leverages 26 naive baselines to diagnose why SZZ implementations succeed or fail, currently shipping 279 scenarios in 17 categories with adapters for four SZZ tools.
